ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Care For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Safety In and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Our ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
